articles.title: HarvestBench: Measuring Whether LLM Agents Will Pay to Avoid Killing Animals
articles.description:

articles.title: From Matching Models to Recruiting Agents: A Systematized Narrative Review of AI Recruitment Systems, Evaluation, and Governance

articles.description:

articles.title: Why Better Models Can Create Riskier Systems: Evidence from LLM Agents in Financial Markets
articles.description:

articles.title: Corporate Language Model (CLM): Transforming Tacit and Fragmented Enterprise Knowledge into a Sovereign, Auditable, and Executable Corporate Intelligence Layer
articles.description:
arXiv:2609.04377v1 Announce Type: new
